evidence.text: The exact Commons record identifies 上-seal.svg as a vector depicting 上 in Shuowen seal-script style. It links the depiction to the s00008 image on 上’s Hanziyuan page and a 27.4E0A image in Sinica’s database. It identifies the file as a modern digital creation and states CC0 1.0/public-domain dedication. The history dates the initial upload to 2006 and a later revision to 2018. This supports file identity, source leads, and reuse metadata; it does not make the image a dated historical artifact.

evidence.text: Inspection of the local SVG path shows one continuous filled silhouette: a long horizontal base, a central upright, and an upper stroke that bends across and descends into the upright. It does not contain a distinct middle stroke extending right. This is a description of the modern rendering, not evidence for a historical stroke sequence or transition.
